# Security

If you find a security problem in Roci, please report it privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/pareekshithbompally/roci/security/advisories/new) rather than
in public. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the Roci version.

Only the latest release is supported. I read every report, but as a personal project I can't promise a response time.

Roci keeps its data on your device and holds no servers or accounts, so reports usually concern the app itself: how it
stores API keys and recordings, the permissions it asks for, its update checks, and the tools and MCP servers it runs.
